normalization: log2_plus_1_only — no size-factor or TMM renormalization (rule R-0073)
model_design: explicit reference level = control; contrast named as factor, treated, control so positive logFC means higher in treated (rule R-0036)
differential_expression: limma eBayes with trend=TRUE and robust=TRUE (rules R-0093, R-0004)

plan.title: Treated vs control muscle DE via limma on log2-TPM
plan.analytical_narrative: The core facility delivered log2(TPM+1) values for 12,000 genes across 12 muscle samples (6 treated vs 6 control), unpaired, single batch. Count-based models (DESeq2/edgeR/voom) are forbidden on normalized abundances (rule R-0004), so differential expression uses limma on the log values with trend=TRUE and robust empirical Bayes (R-0093). Sample structure QC (PCA/MDS, distances) precedes the fit; low-abundance genes are filtered (>= 1 TPM equivalent in at least 6 samples) before the model so the BH adjustment runs over tested genes only; selection is by BH-adjusted p-value (R-0043/R-0044). The report carries method, versions, design, thresholds, n tested, n DE, and session info.
